mapper.select: SELECT qr_login_seq, request_id, request_token_hash, status_cd, approved_user_seq, approved_login_id, approved_user_nm, approved_session_id, mobile_session_id, client_ip, user_agent, expires_at, approved_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM adm_qr_login_req WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

mapper.update: UPDATE adm_qr_login_req SET status_cd = 'APPROVED', approved_user_seq = #{approved_user_seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, approved_login_id = #{approved_login_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, approved_user_nm = #{approved_user_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, approved_session_id = #{approved_session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, mobile_session_id = #{mobile_session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{approved_login_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE request_token_hash = #{request_token_hash} AND status_cd = 'WAITING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM adm_qr_login_req WHERE client_ip = #{clientIp} AND created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{windowSeconds,jdbcType=NUMERIC} * INTERVAL '1 second')
